title: Round22 actual Unit09 front-walk correction remains study-only
summary: Retrieved Round21 audit and the authentic Round20 frames it audited. Confirmed four frames have three alpha silhouettes. Edited connected limb raster chains into eight distinct front-walk poses, preserved violet identity, registered emitter pixels separately, and revised knee and heel contours. Rejected v1 and v2 after review; v3 corrects per-pixel bankers-rounding gaps by rounding each row translation once. Independent local checks verified eight body and lower-body masks, connected alpha, lossless atlas crops and six-layer eight-frame ASE composite roundtrip. Actual opaque support sole pixels stay fixed in a diagnostic stage at root advance 2px per frame; this does not prove runtime gait. Visual and mechanics gates FAIL: soft source clusters, rigid pelvis, incomplete hands and heel roll. Runtime and editor-open NOT TESTED. No engine changes or private art uploaded.
